source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves three alleged channels, false attribution and the pinned day title.
key_decisions.before: not to be quickly shaken from your mind or alarmed, whether by a spirit, a spoken message, or a letter supposedly from us, claiming that the Lord’s day has arrived.
key_decisions.after: not to be quickly shaken from your senses or alarmed, whether by a spirit, a spoken message or a letter supposedly from us, claiming that the day of the Lord has already arrived.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: not to be quickly shaken in mind or alarmed, either by a spirit or a word or a letter as though from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the supplied future logic, rebellion and pinned lawlessness reading.
key_decisions.before: Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,
key_decisions.after: Do not let anyone deceive you in any way. That day will not come unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let no one deceive you in any way; for that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps sweeping self-exaltation, temple action and blasphemous claim.
key_decisions.before: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God’s temple, presenting himself as God.
key_decisions.after: He opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God's temple, presenting himself as God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, declaring himself to be God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the restrainer unnamed and the timing purpose.
key_decisions.before: And now you know what restrains him so that he may be revealed in his own time.
key_decisions.after: And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed at his own time.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed in his time.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the shift from neuter restraint to a personal restrainer without identifying either.
key_decisions.before: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains it will do so until he is out of the way.
key_decisions.after: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one now restraining it will continue until he is out of the way.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains it will do so until he is taken out of the way.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps lethal judgment, breath image and doubled manifestation language.
key_decisions.before: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will destroy with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
key_decisions.after: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the parallel coming and counterfeit power triad.
key_decisions.before: The lawless one’s coming is according to Satan’s working, with every kind of power, false signs and wonders,
key_decisions.after: The lawless one's coming is in accordance with Satan's activity, with every kind of power, false signs and wonders,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The coming of the lawless one is by the activity of Satan with all power and signs and false wonders,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains divine agency in the difficult judgment claim.
key_decisions.before: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they trust the lie,
key_decisions.after: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion, so that they believe the lie,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And for this reason God sends them a working of delusion so that they may believe what is false,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both disbelief and moral delight as grounds.
key_decisions.before: so that all may be judged who did not trust the truth but delighted in unrighteousness.
key_decisions.after: so that all who did not believe the truth but delighted in unrighteousness may be judged.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: in order that all may be judged who did not believe the truth but took pleasure in unrighteousness.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned firstfruits reading and retains both means.
key_decisions.before: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through holiness by the Spirit and trust in the truth.
key_decisions.after: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through the Spirit's sanctifying work and faith in the truth.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But we ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters beloved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves stability, transmitted teaching and both media.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold to the traditions you were taught, whether by our spoken word or by our letter.
key_decisions.after: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions you were taught, whether by our spoken word or by our letter.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions that you were taught, whether by word or by our letter.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the compound subject and the two grace-gifts.
key_decisions.before: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal encouragement and good hope by grace,
key_decisions.after: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
